coverage.notes: One eligible first-stage English-taught first-degree programme is directly identifiable: the Brazilian 2-year Human Resources Management Tecnólogo embedded in Hayek American College. The advertised Business/Computer Science/etc bachelor majors are later partner-institution choices, not extra Hayek first-year degrees. The public 2027-1 (likely February) notice was linked but blocked, and no 2027-2 (normally August) notice was read; the verified 2027 list, deadlines, fees and quotas therefore remain incomplete. General admissions rules are undated unless a historical intake is specified. This is not a claim that a 2027 school leaver can begin the February 2027 semester.

programmes.about: Two-year, English-taught Brazilian technologist degree in Human Resources Management forming the first stage of Hayek's 2+2 overseas bachelor's pathway.
programmes.overview: Students follow an American-style core alongside a Brazilian higher-education qualification in Human Resources Management. Teaching is in English at the Brasília campus: students attend the classroom while international instructors teach live online, with practical projects and cross-border online collaboration. A Guided Aspiration Quest each semester supports personal skills development, while internships may be facilitated. After the first two years, students may continue at an overseas university for a separate bachelor's; major, credit transfer and remaining duration depend on the destination.

claims.statement: The provider is Faculdade Hayek Global College, a privately maintained Brazilian higher-education college located in Asa Norte, Brasília. It is maintained by Agatti Educacional Limitada and promotes an English-medium undergraduate pathway.
